name: feature-flag-manager
description: Small application for viewing, toggling, and creating feature flags

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit
